methods.title: Inspect Relay runtime
methods.description: Read the current editor or game mode, pause, frame, simulation time and resolution state.

methods.title: Run game
methods.description: Start a temporary game session from the authored scene. Stop restores the authored scene and discards runtime changes.

methods.title: Stop game
methods.description: Stop the current game session and restore the authored scene without changing undo history.

methods.title: Pause Relay runtime
methods.description: Pause a running game so its scene can be inspected deterministically.

methods.title: Resume Relay runtime
methods.description: Resume a paused game after inspection or a controlled frame step.

methods.title: Step Relay frames
methods.description: Advance an exact number of deterministic game frames, including while paused.

params.name: frames
params.description: Number of frames to advance

methods.title: Shut down Relay runtime
methods.description: Request an orderly shutdown of the runtime owned by this MCP bridge.

methods.title: Inspect editor camera
methods.description: Read the live editor inspection viewpoint used by Vulkan captures. Unavailable without an editor. Does not modify scene cameras.

methods.title: Position editor inspection camera
methods.description: Set the live inspector camera target, orbit angles in radians and distance for visual confirmation using render_capture source vulkan. View-only: no scene or undo changes.

methods.title: Frame entity in inspection camera
methods.description: Frame an entity and its descendant bounds in the live inspection view before Vulkan capture. Does not change selection, scene cameras or undo history.

methods.title: Capture Relay frame
methods.description: Save the current rendered frame in Relay's captures directory for visual inspection.

params.name: filename
params.description: Safe PNG or BMP filename without directory components

params.name: source
params.description: Vulkan captures a real GPU frame; deterministic uses the headless CPU oracle

methods.title: Queue Relay frame capture
methods.description: Capture real Vulkan or deterministic CPU frames through bounded background image workers.

params.name: filename
params.description: Safe PNG or BMP filename without directory components

params.name: source
params.description: Capture provenance; omitted uses the active renderer. Vulkan requires a live editor.

methods.title: Cancel pending capture
methods.description: Cancel a queued image or GPU readback job; writing and completed jobs cannot be cancelled. GPU slots remain alive until their fence completes.

methods.title: Inspect capture job
methods.description: Check whether an asynchronous capture is queued, writing, complete or failed.

methods.title: Inspect graphics capabilities
methods.description: Create a temporary Vulkan device and report adapter and modern rendering support.

methods.title: Inspect render graph
methods.description: Read compiled render passes, resources, dependencies and access transitions.

methods.title: Inspect shader interfaces
methods.description: Read SPIR-V-reflected stages, locations, descriptor bindings and push-constant sizes from the live Vulkan pipeline.

methods.title: Inspect upload memory
methods.description: Read Vulkan asset upload budgets, staging peaks, estimated resident bytes and transfer-path state.

methods.title: Inspect render assets
methods.description: List built-in and imported meshes, materials and textures currently available to scene renderer components.

methods.title: Inspect model import formats
methods.description: Report model formats and feature coverage available in this Relay build, including Godot-compatible interchange paths.

methods.title: Import project model
methods.description: Import a model from the project-local assets directory using a content-addressed identity and optionally instantiate its node hierarchy.

params.name: filename
params.description: Project-relative model path; traversal and symlinks are rejected

params.name: instantiate
params.description: Create the imported model hierarchy in the active scene

params.name: preset
params.description: Scene preserves conversion-time animation, camera and light data; static_mesh strips those channels

methods.title: Browse project files
methods.description: List the folders and files in one project folder, folders first, with each entry's asset kind. Hidden entries, symlinks and .relayproject files are omitted; importable models are marked.

params.name: directory
params.description: Project-relative folder; empty lists the project root

methods.title: Search project files
methods.description: Find project files and folders anywhere below the project root whose names contain the query, optionally limited to asset kinds. Hidden entries, symlinks and .relayproject files are skipped; at most 512 results.

params.name: query
params.description: Case-insensitive name fragment; empty matches every name

params.name: kinds
params.description: Asset kinds to include; omitted or empty includes all

methods.title: Create project folder
methods.description: Create a new, empty folder inside an existing project folder.

params.name: path
params.description: Project-relative path of the new folder

methods.title: Rename or move project file
methods.description: Rename or move a project file or folder without overwriting. Import records follow moved models; project scene files and the project file cannot move.

params.name: from
params.description: Existing project-relative path

params.name: to
params.description: New project-relative path; its folder must exist

methods.title: Delete project file
methods.description: Move a project file or folder into the hidden .relay-trash folder, where it can be recovered by hand. Project scene files and the project file cannot be deleted.

params.name: path
params.description: Project-relative file or folder

methods.title: Read Relay logs
methods.description: Read structured engine log entries newer than a sequence number.

params.name: after
params.description: Last sequence number already seen

methods.title: Read Relay performance
methods.description: Read bounded per-frame CPU/GPU timing, draw/resource counts, entities and process memory.

methods.title: Read recent Relay input
methods.description: Read the bounded normalized keyboard, mouse and gamepad input event history.

methods.title: Read input map
methods.description: Read the project's input map: named actions bound to keys, mouse buttons or gamepad buttons, and axes built from button pairs or gamepad sticks. Also returns the engine defaults. Controls look like key:space, key:left_shift, mouse:left, gamepad:a or gamepad:leftx.

methods.title: Replace input map
methods.description: Validate, save in the project file (settings.input in the .relayproject) and apply a complete input map document (format relay.input, version 1) as returned by input.map.

params.name: map
params.description: The whole input map as JSON text

methods.title: Inspect game input
methods.description: Read the current game step's input: each action's held and pressed state, each axis value, held controls and mouse movement.

methods.title: Simulate game input
methods.description: Hold an action, or set an axis value, for a number of game steps during Run Game, as if a player pressed it. Use it with runtime.step to play-test scripts.

params.name: name
params.description: Action or axis name from input.map

params.name: value
params.description: Axis value; actions ignore it

methods.title: Release game input
methods.description: Host-only. Release every held control, used when the game viewport loses input focus.

methods.title: Start Relay video
methods.description: Record real Vulkan or deterministic CPU frames to WebM with explicit frame drops.

params.name: filename
params.description: Safe WebM filename without directory components

params.name: source
params.description: Capture provenance; omitted uses the active renderer. Vulkan requires a live editor.

methods.title: Inspect video capabilities
methods.description: Report whether this Relay build found the FFmpeg WebM encoder.

methods.title: Stop Relay video
methods.description: Drain pending readbacks and start background WebM finalization; poll video.status for completion and errors.

methods.title: Inspect Relay video
methods.description: Read recording state, submitted frames and explicitly reported frame drops.

methods.title: List scene entities
methods.description: List every live entity with its name, parent and local transform.

methods.title: Inspect scene entity
methods.description: Inspect one entity using its stable generation-checked handle.

params.name: entity
params.description: Generation-checked Relay entity handle such as 0:1

methods.title: Create scene node
methods.description: Create a node, optionally of a node type from nodes.types (which gives it that type's components, inherited from its ancestors) and optionally parented to another live node.

params.name: name
params.description: Node name; defaults to the type's name, or Entity

params.name: parent
params.description: Optional parent entity handle

params.name: type
params.description: Node type to create; omitted creates a plain Node

methods.title: Destroy scene entity
methods.description: Destroy an entity and its descendants as one undoable transaction.

methods.title: Duplicate scene entity
methods.description: Copy an entity and its descendants beside the original as one undoable transaction. Components are preserved, a copied camera is never the active one, and a copy of a whole imported model drives its own animation.

methods.title: Clear the scene
methods.description: Destroy every entity as one undoable transaction, leaving an empty scene to start new work in.

methods.title: Set entity transform
methods.description: Update selected local position, Euler rotation or scale fields in one transaction.

params.name: gesture
params.description: Nonzero token identifying one continuous drag. Updates sharing a token fold into a single undo step; use a fresh token per gesture

methods.title: Configure entity camera
methods.description: Add, update or remove a perspective or orthographic camera; activating one deactivates the previous camera.

params.name: orthographicHeight
params.description: Full viewport height; zero selects perspective

params.name: exposureEv
params.description: Exposure compensation in stops; zero is the reference exposure

methods.title: Configure entity renderer
methods.description: Attach a registered built-in or imported mesh and material to an entity, or remove its renderer component.

methods.title: Set entity parent
methods.description: Reparent an entity safely; use null to move it to the scene root.

methods.title: Undo scene change
methods.description: Undo the most recent scene transaction and restore exact entity generations.

methods.title: Redo scene change
methods.description: Reapply the most recently undone scene transaction.

methods.title: Control imported animation
methods.description: Configure clip, playback, looping, speed and seek time on an imported model root.

params.name: gesture
params.description: Shared token for updates in one scrub gesture; zero creates a separate undo entry

methods.title: Set imported morph weight
methods.description: Override a mesh morph weight, or reset all overrides to imported defaults and animation.

methods.title: Configure collider
methods.description: Add, edit or remove an authored box, sphere, capsule, convex or triangle-mesh collider. Sphere and capsule use the largest world scale uniformly. Convex and mesh shapes use a registered mesh, defaulting to the entity renderer mesh. Undoable and saved with the scene.

params.name: mesh
params.description: Registered mesh for convex and mesh shapes; empty uses the entity renderer mesh

methods.title: Raycast colliders
methods.description: Find the nearest enabled authored collider of any shape hit by a world-space ray. Returns hit point and surface normal; does not move objects.

methods.title: Find overlapping colliders
methods.description: List up to 128 enabled colliders of any shape overlapping an entity collider. Both colliders must pass their layer masks; reports truncation. Triangle-mesh colliders report surface contact only.

methods.title: Inspect collider wireframes
methods.description: Read bounded world-space collider outlines for the editor overlay, including disabled colliders.

methods.title: Inspect physics body
methods.description: Read the current linear and angular velocities of a dynamic body during Run Game.

methods.title: Read collision contacts
methods.description: Read bounded contact begin and end events from the current game session, using a sequence cursor. Events are cleared on Stop Game.

params.name: after
params.description: Last contact event sequence already seen

methods.title: Apply rigid body impulse
methods.description: Apply a world-space impulse to a dynamic body during Run Game. Optional world-space point produces torque and angular motion.

methods.title: Configure physics body
methods.description: Add, edit or remove an undoable static or dynamic physics body. Dynamic bodies use Jolt rigid-body collision, gravity and angular dynamics during Run Game.

params.name: lockRotation
params.description: Keep a dynamic body upright, as character controllers need

methods.title: Inspect gameplay scripts
methods.description: Read native C++ script state: project trust, build state, whether sources changed since the last build, registered behaviours, compiler diagnostics with file and line, and runtime errors from behaviour callbacks.

methods.title: Build gameplay scripts
methods.description: Compile the project's scripts/ C++ files into a native library in the background; unchanged files are reused. Poll scripts.status until the state is ready or failed. A build that finishes during Run Game hot reloads the running behaviours. Requires a project a person has trusted.

methods.title: Trust project scripts
methods.description: Host-only. Allow or forbid building and running this project's native C++ scripts, which run with the editor's full privileges. Stored per user, outside the project.

methods.title: Read script SDK
methods.description: Return relay_script.hpp, the complete C++ API available to gameplay scripts, with usage notes and frame order. Read it before writing a script.

methods.title: Read script source
methods.description: Read a C++ source or header from the project's scripts/ folder.

params.name: path
params.description: Path inside scripts/, such as player.cpp or ai/enemy.hpp

methods.title: Write script source
methods.description: Create or replace a C++ source or header in the project's scripts/ folder, creating subfolders. Allowed during Run Game; build afterwards to compile it or hot reload it.

params.name: path
params.description: Path inside scripts/, such as player.cpp or ai/enemy.hpp

params.name: source
params.description: Complete file contents

methods.title: Create behaviour script
methods.description: Create scripts/<behaviour>.cpp from a starter template defining and registering that behaviour class. Refuses to overwrite.

params.name: behaviour
params.description: C++ class name of the new behaviour

methods.title: List component types
methods.description: List every component a node can carry: engine components with their category and whether they can be added, removed or repeated, plus each built script behaviour with its declared properties and code defaults.

methods.title: Configure joint
methods.description: Add, edit or remove an undoable joint linking this node's physics body to another node's body, or to the world when connected is empty, during Run Game. Types: fixed (weld), point (ball and socket), hinge (turns about axis, optional angle limits in degrees with min in [-180, 0] and max in [0, 180], optional motor), slider (moves along axis, optional travel limits in metres with min <= 0 <= max, optional motor) and distance (rope or spring between anchor and connected_anchor; limits are lengths, otherwise the starting length is kept). Anchor and axis are in this node's local space; connected_anchor is in the connected node's space, or world space for the world. At least one body must be dynamic. Joined bodies do not collide unless collide_connected is set. Changing type resets the limits to that type's defaults unless limits are given too.

params.name: connected
params.description: Handle of the node to join; empty for the world

params.name: motorSpeed
params.description: Degrees per second for hinges, metres per second for sliders

params.name: motorForce
params.description: Maximum torque (N m) for hinges, force (N) for sliders

params.name: springFrequency
params.description: Distance joints: spring frequency in Hz; 0 is rigid

methods.title: Add component
methods.description: Add an engine component with editor defaults, or append a script component running a behaviour, as one undoable transaction. Configure it afterwards with the component's own method, such as scene.set_camera or scene.set_script_property.

params.name: behaviour
params.description: Behaviour class name; required for script

methods.title: Remove component
methods.description: Remove one component as an undoable transaction. The Transform and imported model animation cannot be removed.

params.name: index
params.description: Which script component, from zero

methods.title: Configure script component
methods.description: Change the behaviour or enabled state of one of a node's script components, as an undoable transaction.

params.name: index
params.description: Position among the node's script components, from zero

methods.title: Set script property
methods.description: Store a value for a behaviour property on one script component, or reset it to the code default. Send exactly one of number, boolean, text or vector unless resetting.

params.name: index
params.description: Position among the node's script components, from zero

methods.title: List node types
methods.description: List the node type tree. Each type adds components to its parent's; creatable types can be passed to scene.create. A node's reported type is the deepest type whose components it has.

methods.title: List node templates
methods.description: List the project's saved templates (prefabs) with the node type each root inherits and the root's components and script behaviours. Built-in node types are listed by nodes.types.

methods.title: Create node from template
methods.description: Create a saved node tree from a project template as one undoable transaction and return its root. The result is an independent copy.

params.name: template
params.description: Template id from templates.list, such as project:Enemy

params.name: parent
params.description: Optional parent entity

params.name: name
params.description: Optional name for the root node

methods.title: Save node as template
methods.description: Save a node and its children as a project template in templates/<name>.relay-template.json, usable from the Create menu and templates.instantiate.

params.name: replace
params.description: Overwrite an existing template of that name

methods.title: Configure scene light
methods.description: Add, update or remove a directional, point or spot light.

params.name: range
params.description: Light range; zero means infinite

methods.title: Rename scene entity
methods.description: Change an entity's display name as one undoable transaction.

methods.title: Inspect undo history
methods.description: Read the labels currently on the undo and redo stacks, newest first.

methods.title: List importable models
methods.description: List model files present in the project assets directory that this build can import. Top-level files only; the import sandbox is unchanged.

methods.title: Pick scene entity
methods.description: Find the nearest drawable entity a world-space ray enters. Bounds-level precision, not per-triangle. Stateless: the caller supplies the ray, so the engine stores no viewpoint.

methods.title: Inspect entity bounds
methods.description: Read the world-space axis-aligned bounds and origin of an entity and its descendants, for framing a selection or locating an object.

methods.title: Snapshot Relay scene
methods.description: Return deterministic scene JSON plus reflected component field metadata.

methods.title: Save Relay scene
methods.description: Atomically save the current scene in Relay's project-local scenes directory.

params.name: filename
params.description: Safe scene filename without directory components

methods.title: Load Relay scene
methods.description: Validate, migrate and load a project scene as one undoable transaction.

methods.title: Start Relay trace
methods.description: Record frame-stamped agent commands and normalized human input events.

params.name: filename
params.description: Safe Relay trace filename without directory components

methods.title: Stop Relay trace
methods.description: Atomically persist the active deterministic trace in Relay's traces directory.

methods.title: Inspect Relay trace
methods.description: Read trace recording state, path and current event count.

methods.title: Replay Relay trace
methods.description: Validate and replay a trace against the fixed-step runtime at its recorded frame offsets.

methods.title: Copy
methods.description: Copy selected subtrees to the session clipboard without changing the scene.

methods.title: Cut
methods.description: Copy and remove selected subtrees as one undoable edit.

methods.title: Duplicate Many
methods.description: Duplicate selected subtrees beside their originals as one undoable edit.

methods.title: Destroy Many
methods.description: Remove selected subtrees as one undoable edit.

methods.title: Transform Many
methods.description: Apply a column-major world-space affine delta matrix to selected roots as one undoable gesture.

methods.title: Paste entities
methods.description: Paste the session clipboard as one undoable edit; cameras stay inactive and internal model bindings are remapped.

methods.title: Inspect clipboard
methods.description: Read session clipboard root and entity counts.

methods.title: Create project
methods.description: Create a folder project (.relayproject) and an empty scene; refuses to overwrite an existing project.

methods.title: Open project
methods.description: Open a folder project (.relayproject) and load its startup scene atomically, or clear the scene for an empty project.

methods.title: Status project
methods.description: Inspect the current project, member scene files and startup scene.

methods.title: List project
methods.description: List available workspace project files.

methods.title: Add Scene project
methods.description: Add an existing valid scene file to the current project; the first scene becomes its startup scene.

methods.title: Remove Scene project
methods.description: Remove scene membership without deleting its file; chooses a remaining startup scene when needed.

methods.title: Set Startup project
methods.description: Choose a current project member as the startup scene.

methods.title: Close project
methods.description: Close project metadata while leaving the current scene intact.

methods.title: Package project
methods.description: Export saved project metadata, member scenes and non-hidden assets as a portable uncompressed tar under the project exports directory. Refuses to overwrite; save scene changes first.

methods.title: Set transform keyframe
methods.description: Add or update a scene-owned transform keyframe at an exact time. Unspecified transform fields use the current entity transform or existing key. Undoable and saved with the scene.

methods.title: Delete transform keyframe
methods.description: Remove one scene-owned transform keyframe at an exact time as an undoable edit.

methods.title: Control transform keyframes
methods.description: Set playback, loop, speed, duration or current time for scene-owned transform keys. Undoable and saved with the scene.

methods.title: Control animation tracks
methods.description: Seek or configure multiple animation roots in one undoable gesture; time clamps to each clip duration.

params.name: gesture
params.description: Shared token for updates in one scrub gesture; zero creates a separate undo entry

methods.title: Inspect animation timeline
methods.description: Read bounded channel key times for an imported animation clip. Key times are read-only; truncated channels report their full key count.

methods.title: Inspect session grants
methods.description: Inspect exact native method grants for this connection. Grants are approved only by the host; no tool can expand them.

methods.title: Inspect session audit
methods.description: Read bounded session action decisions and outcomes. Scope is the exact native method. Oldest sequence exposes eviction; parameters are not retained.

methods.title: Session request
methods.description: Request host approval for an exact method and optional entity/file target. This never grants access or executes an action.

methods.title: Session review
methods.description: Inspect pending requests, active scoped grants and native action descriptions.

methods.title: Session grant
methods.description: Host approval of an exact method scope bound to the current project.

methods.title: Session decide
methods.description: Host approval or denial of a pending request. Stale project requests cannot be approved.

methods.title: Session revoke
methods.description: Host revocation of all grants or one exact method.

methods.title: Session export_audit
methods.description: Export a bounded audit snapshot atomically under .relay/audits without overwriting existing records.

methods.title: Chat submit
methods.description: Submit a user message to the external bridge. Providers and canonical conversation history remain outside the engine.

methods.title: Chat status
methods.description: Inspect the bounded external bridge display and pending user-message count.

methods.title: Bridge poll
methods.description: Consume bounded user-message submissions for the authenticated external bridge.

methods.title: Bridge publish
methods.description: Publish a bounded display snapshot from the authenticated external bridge.

methods.title: Stop chat work
methods.description: Cancel pending chat submissions and ask the external bridge to abort its active turn. Completed native actions remain undoable.

methods.title: Auto approval
methods.description: Set full session access to every public engine action without approval prompts. Trusted host only.

methods.title: Configure chat provider
methods.description: Pass transient provider settings to the external bridge for private storage. Never traced or exposed to agent tools.

methods.title: Control agent harness
methods.description: Host-only OpenAI sign-in, account, model, reasoning and conversation controls, processed by the external bridge.
